about: The /cut kit's ingredients as they exist in Amir's Motion Menu. One record per ingredient: the menu item (name, label, takes, farsi, used, pairs, like), the kit block that builds it (cut, how), what he said about it (said, mark: keep or drop, only where he gave a verdict) and where its sample sits on a showreel (sample: showreel number, t0, t1, poster, in seconds). `no` is the menu number and never changes. Add a record here, make its sample (tools/menu_samples.py), then publish (kit/MENU.md).

groups.name: Over your video
groups.blurb: Sits on your own picture. Your face stays. Built in your /cut kit.

groups.name: Behind you
groups.blurb: Words and numbers between the wall and you. Needs you cut out of the picture.

groups.name: Full-screen cards
groups.blurb: Takes over the whole screen while your voice carries on.

groups.name: Wipes and cuts
groups.blurb: How a card or a shot hands over to the next one, on your own footage.

items.name: Drum on Video
items.label: A list turns on a drum over your chest, one line at a time, then opens flat. Your face stays.

items.name: Steps
items.label: Steps joined by arrows, built as you say each one. A row for short words, a stack for long phrases. Your face stays.
items.how: K.diagram(steps, {at, nodeAt, out})  (mode video, layout auto)
items.said: You prefer this to the full card

items.name: Loop
items.label: Four steps in a circle: the last arrow runs back to the first and everything lights. Over your video.

items.name: Chapter Band
items.label: A clay band across your chest names each part. The number rolls like a counter and the title lands. Your face stays.
items.how: K.chapter(n, title, {variant:"band", at, landAt, titleAt, out, total})
items.said: You prefer this to the full card

items.name: Checklist
items.label: Rules arrive as you name them, then each one gets ticked.

items.name: Chips
items.label: Options pop in one by one as you say them.

items.name: Stamp
items.label: One clay stamp per spoken word. It pops, slides or drops in.

items.name: Stamp Mask
items.label: A small dark stamp wipes in from the side.

items.name: Tag
items.label: A small stamp beside you with a ring burst. Often over a huge faint number.
items.how: K.tag(word, {at, x, y, out})  (with K.ghost for the faint number)

items.name: Call to Action
items.label: A comment bubble pops with the ask, and a small line under it.

items.name: Word Behind
items.label: One word appears behind your head, with the room dimmed. Needs you cut out.

items.name: Word Stack
items.label: Lines of type rise one by one behind you.
items.how: K.stack(seg, lines, {at, out, top, size})  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Hollow Word
items.label: A giant hollow word draws on behind you, then can fill solid.
items.how: K.outline(seg, word, {at, fillAt, out, size})  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Drifting Rows
items.label: Rows of one word slide slowly behind you at different speeds.
takes: the speed and direction of each row
items.how: K.drift(seg, word, {at, out, rows})  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Studio Swap
items.label: The room turns into a studio colour and only you stay. You sink a little to make room for type.
items.how: K.backdrop(seg, {at, out, tone, variant})  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Number Behind
items.label: A number rolls behind your head like an odometer and lands with a ring. A small unit stamps on your chest.
takes: the small unit on your chest
items.how: K.backdrop + K.slamBehind(seg, number, {at, landAt, out}) + K.tag(unit)  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Soft Room
items.label: The room goes soft and dark while you stay sharp.
items.how: K.focus(seg, {at, out, blur, dim})  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Head Glow
items.label: A soft glow, a ring or a flat disc behind your head.
items.how: K.halo(seg, {kind, tone, at, out})  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Light Sweep
items.label: A soft band of light crosses the wall behind you.
items.how: K.sweep(seg, {at, d, dir, tone})  (needs the cut-out)

items.name: Question Card
items.label: A full clay card with one line slammed as a stamp, while your voice carries on.

items.name: Number Slam
items.label: A number rolls like an odometer and lands with a slam. Its unit drops in below.

items.name: Versus
items.label: A split screen: two sides slide in and meet on a slanted seam. Add a verdict and the seam moves.
items.how: K.versus(a, b, {vs, win, winAt, at, out})

items.name: Drum
items.label: A list turns on a 3D drum one line at a time, then opens flat.

items.name: Quote Page
items.label: A page falls onto a dark table, lines are written in and one is highlighted.

items.name: Steps Card
items.label: The steps as a full-screen staircase of plates, built as you say each one.
items.said: Good. You prefer it on your video when the words fit

items.name: Loop Card
items.label: Four plates in a loop on a full card. The last arrow runs back to the first and a mark turns.
items.how: K.diagram(steps, {mode:"card", layout:"cycle", at, nodeAt, loopAt, out})

items.name: Chapter Card
items.label: The whole screen goes clay: a huge faint number rolls to the next part and the title is slammed in.
items.how: K.chapter(n, title, {variant:"card", at, landAt, titleAt, out, total})
items.said: Very good. You prefer the band

items.name: Curve and Slope
items.label: A force-time graph: the axes draw, a curve draws with a glowing head, and its slope is marked with its rise and run.
takes: the two words on the axes
items.how: K.curve({at, out, yLabel, xLabel, curves:[{at, tone:"clay", x0, k}], slope:{at, label}})

items.name: Time Saved
items.label: Two curves reach the same peak. The faster one gets there sooner and the time saved lights up on the axis.
takes: the label for the time saved
items.how: K.curve({at, out, curves:[slow, fast], gap:{at, level, label}})

items.name: Muscle Map
items.label: The app's own body. Muscles light up as you say them, with a label, and the body turns round to show the back.
items.how: K.bodymap([{m, label, at, view, side}], {at, out})
items.said: Amazing. Use it whenever you talk about a place in the body

items.name: Joint Chain
items.label: Hip, knee and ankle light in order and a pulse runs down the leg.

items.name: Court Steps
items.label: A court in 3D. A ball is struck, a runner takes a few steps to it and leaves ghosts, and numbers stand up.
items.how: K.courtSteps3d({at, hit, steps, arrive, out, line1, line2})

items.name: Court Distance
items.label: A court in 3D. A measuring line, a sprint along it and numbers rising at each mark.
items.how: K.courtMeasure3d({at, label, labelAt, sprintAt, out, value, unit})

items.name: Clay Wipe
items.label: A clay line sweeps right to left and the next card follows it.
items.how: wipeVariant:"clay" on a card, or K.wipeIn(layer, t, d, "clay")

items.name: Iris
items.label: A circle opens like an eye into the next card.

items.name: Push
items.label: The next card slides over the picture.

items.name: Slice
items.label: Six bars step in from the right and the next card follows.

items.name: Zoom Through
items.label: A circle opens while the next card rushes in.

items.name: Whip Wipe
items.label: A fast slide with heavy blur carries the next card in.

items.name: Whip Cut
items.label: The picture blurs and slides away to hide a jump cut.

items.name: Zoom Cut
items.label: A quick push through the picture hides a jump cut.
